lines: Amrit Pratik Acharya, a Promoter Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 14,230,672 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹214.88 crore are scheduled on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer document timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares face lock-in: 18 months for minimum promoter contribution and 6 months for holdings above 20%, so more liquidity comes later.
Unknown: average cost of acquisition and pre-offer holding, so gain and retained value cannot be stated.
